jobs.description: ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD. At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career. THE ROLE: Lead the global product marketing organization for AMD’s Data Center GPU portfolio, connecting market insight, product and software value propositions, partner go-to-market strategy, launch execution, and customer adoption. This leader will translate business and product strategy into an integrated marketing agenda across AI, HPC, OEM/ODM, cloud and ecosystem motions, while building a scalable, high-performing global team. THE PERSON: A strategic, externally credible marketing executive who combines deep knowledge of AI and data center markets with disciplined operating leadership. They bring sound judgment, strong executive presence, a customer-first orientation, and a track record of developing global teams in a fast-moving environment. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS: Extensive experience in product marketing, segment marketing, go-to-market strategy or related leadership roles in semiconductors, AI infrastructure, enterprise technology, cloud or data center markets. Demonstrated success defining product positioning, market strategy and integrated go-to-market plans for technically complex portfolios. Proven leadership of major, cross-functional launches and executive-level content, with strong judgment around technical claims and external communications. Experience building joint marketing programs with OEMs, ODMs, cloud providers, software partners, ISVs or other ecosystem participants. Strong business and financial acumen, including annual planning, investment prioritization, budget stewardship and outcome measurement. Ability to influence at executive and C-suite levels internally and externally, navigate ambiguity, resolve competing priorities and drive accountability across functions. Exceptional written, verbal and presentation skills, with the ability to make complex technologies and market dynamics clear and compelling. Willingness to travel globally for customer, partner, team and industry engagements. Knowledge of hardware and software product lifecycles, performance marketing, developer and ISV ecosystems, and partner-led selling motions. Experience scaling a marketing organization during a period of rapid market growth, portfolio expansion or business transformation. Established credibility with industry analysts, press, developers, customers, partners and executive stakeholders. A sharp, detail-driven eye that catches the number that doesn't hold up, the logic that doesn't sequence, and the risk before it becomes a delay.
The versatility to move fluidly between the field, the GC, Finance, and the executive table, tailoring the message to each without losing the thread.
A bias for order and structure — you bring discipline to controls, documentation, and reporting in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.
